book.name: Mak
book.title: Mak Makho Fatmata ogepma irim togoc

content: Yesuho amna audecma dogu boyömo dong yandoc
Oro mit Yesuot youp amnaniot yu Galili yamuc öngkoring gino okocene ongga Gerasa nanohon guroc woce ongkubung.
Ong-kungmuya Yesu yu girangdecma bangmun möngina wohogon amna au dogu boyömnima yu domdomgon Yesuot eboc.
Amna wo yu amna fiiyan kumkumon sa woce itongidoc. Yui amna dunggit sinom idocmaha amna auho yu sogida orung oburo yi koingodechu o sendechu feto akep toctocno woi maidoc.
Suraroho wömai amna wo sendec akep tongo singidung mahong yu kudat tongga sen orin hankap doun dogiuya ongidoc. Worocha wömai amna auho yu sogit sogitno wömai maididoc. Muno yu amna orongi sinom.
Yu wömai sepno sepno o kumbongno kumbongno amna kumkumonthu o sa urongodechu woce mata kararatgon yongmuna itongo sopdec inoin godip föbo mang tongidoc.
Oro, amna worocho korungon ida Yesu angmuna domdomgon ohongmuna Yesuhon orungo forodec möngga

idina Yesuho inogoc, “Goc dogu wontucmuno, goc amna ngo imi fauna ongoi!” Ihoroc inuna amna wo mata kararat sinom yongga yogoc, “Ayöö Yesu, gocu Kopotoroc onoce sinom yuhon Manano, goc yaö tong namnampha eparoc? Goc Kopotorochon madec yong koing yoi, goc focfoc namongga noc ti obökitha,” dogu wontucmuno amnadec idocma yu ihoroc mambodoc.
Tuna Yesu inogoc, “Goc maya numa?” Ihoroc inuna dogu worocho yogoc, “Non toropnaiu koböc, worocha noc mana ami, ihoroc.”
Ihoroc inongga yu ‘Yesu noc sa guroc audec nanong muicyit’ yongo Yesu dönacgon inong tohogoc.
Oro, sa urongo woce wömai bot torop moröma sinom ambehecgon nacno nongga idung.
Tuna dogu boyömpho Yesu mata orongi ingoroc inogung, “Gocho non ning banangga niria bot irotnon ohona.”

Ihoroc inuna Yesu yu kombing imuna dogu boyömpho amna wo imu fauna bot irotnon ohongbödegung. Ohongbödeuya bot torop wo yu domdomgon ohongga sa bohöng yamuc öngkoring ganang ohongga omongbödegung. Bot worochon nambano wömai 2,000 ihoroc ombung.

Ihoroc tuya amna bot wo yangtorengidungma yu yapmu woroc angbotongmuya domdomgon ongga worochon fatno inoin böcsanodechu o böc au ambehec idungma woce inong tonggung. Tuya böc moröm yu ‘tingting sinom öngkuboc’ yongo Yesuot ebung.
Engga agungmai, amna dogu boyömonima yu boru temongga kombiun tuctuc yuna idoc. Ihoroc idina angmuya owi amnaho botogung.
Tuna amna yapmu öngkubocma wo ino darodec agungma yu owi amna worochon fatno fandat inogung. Woi Yesuho dogu dong yandocma o ihorocgon botho yaö kiap togungma worochon fatno inongdup togung.
Ihoroc inuya kombingga yu ‘Yesu sa guroc wo imun fauna sa auhon ongoun’ yongo mata orongi inogung.
Tuna Yesu yu girangdec bangmun uuna amna dogu kopot boyömonima dong yan imogocma yu ‘Yesuot ongowa’ yongo Yesu dönac orongi inogoc
mahong Yesuho ‘muno’ yongo ingoroc inogoc, “Goc böcan ongmina Morömaho goc gang banango ogepma sinom tongfat gegocma worochon fatno nip oröcai iniruc.”

Yesuho ihoroc inuna amna wo ongga guroc au mano ‘ten taun’ woce itongmuna Yesuho ogepma sinom tongfat yegocma worochon fatno owi amnadec yong moröging tonguna owi amnaho fatno kombingga nanga fatfat togung.
Yesuho amna moröma auhon weno orin owi au dongyun orokogomoroc
Oro, Yesu yu wönggon Galili yamuc öngkoring ökene ongga idina owi amna koböcma sinom Yesuot engmuya suran togung. Oro Yesu yu abe yamuc öngkoring tan
idina Israel nanohon fatmata yocyoc böc angtorec amna au mano Yairus yu eboc. Yu engmuna Yesuhon orungo forodec goruc yemoc tongga
Yesu dönac orongi ingoroc inogoc, “Nochon wena obugu yu omompha tac. Worocha goc engmina obura yudec siia orokongga itonggongno wönggon sogiun.”
Yairusho ihoroc inuna Yesu yuot onggoc. Yu uyapdec ongga idinya owi amna koböcmaho yu yan fongga nucno köreun köreun toup tong tonggung.
Tuya owi au yu owi amna bonipnodec ongtonggoc. Yu wömai nogotnoho wuna biruc 12 ihoroc idoc.

Tuna dokta koböcmaho yu tu orokoc orokocha tu matuna focfoc morö kombingidoc. O yu doktahon wöngnacnoha mönengno ambarac komanang imun fadidoc mahong obukocnoho wömai mabödegoc. Muno sinom, obukocho yudec koingo sinom idoc.
Oro owi wo yu Yesuhon fatno moröma kombigocmaha engga owi amna koböcmaho bonipnodec Yesuhon menon ongmuna oburoho Yesuhon tec tohomunmöcno wot mögoc.
Yu wömai kombigoc, ‘Nocho Yesuhon tec tohomunmöcno wot muantatanu wömai orokontat.’
Ihoroc kombingga tecno wot möngmuuna wohogon nogotnoho manman yogoc. Tuna owi wo yu kombigoc, focfocho godip föbna urop imun fauna orokotat.
Ihoroc tuna Yesu yu kombigocmai, gesö auho yu imun fadoc. Ihoroc kombingga ibarun faunto owi amna inong ac tongga yogoc, “Numaho nochon tecna wot möhac yo?”
Ihoroc yuna youp amnaniho yogung, “Ahi, owi amna koböcma sinompho goc gang arenggumbec tongga nucno köreun köreun tongga ida goc got muang. Worocha goc tingtinga yaroc numaho noc not möhac yo?”
Ihoroc inogung mahong Yesu yu kiringga ‘numaho toc’ yongo owi amna foring yang tonggoc.
Ihoroc tuna owi wo yu kiapmo yudec öngkubocma woha kombingga botongga kudat konoc konoc tongga Yesuot engmuna orungo forodec goruc yemoc tong imongga fatno Yesu inong taboc.
Inong tauna Yesuho inogoc, “Wena, goc kombing tobing namparocmaha tongga orokotaroc. Goc irot gucot ongoi. Obukoca wönggon maehic,” Yesuho owi wo ihoroc inogoc.
Oro, Yesu yu abe mata yongo idina Yairusho bucinma amna auho engmuya Yairus inogung, “Weya urop omec, worocha goc fandat fandat amna ngo youp komanang imirocha.”
Yu Yairus ihoroc inogung mahong Yesuho mata worocha onggim masii Yairus inogoc, “Goc botirocha, nocgon kombing tobing nampi,”
Ihoroc inongga Yesuho ‘owi amna koböcma non ningat fongoninga’ yongo yu yang firigoc. Tuna Pita, orin yan oröcma Jems orin Jön, yuhogon wömai Yesuot onggung.
Ongga Yairusho bucin ongkungmuya yagungmai owi amna koböcmaho woce itfat yongga itmuya yong yaingga yong uroc ap yongga idung.
Tuya Yesu yu böc ganang öngmuna owi amna inogoc, “Son yaöha yong oin tongga yong uroc ap yongga idang? Managumboc yu mamec. Yui komanang dungga itac.”

Yesuho ihoroc inuna owi amnaho angyogudung. Ihoroc tuya Yesuho owi amna ambarac dong yaruna taitdec ohogung. Tuna managumbochon macnin fanin, o youp amnani anfi worochogon wömai Yesuot böc irotnon managumbocho idocan wocin onggung.
Ongmuya Yesuho managumbochon oburo sogitmuna inogoc, “Talita kum!” Mata worochon foroi ingoroc: ‘Owi obugu, nocho gantat, goc idongoi!’
Ihoroc inuna wohogon owi obugu wo idongga böc irotnon itonggoc. Tuna owi amna woce idungmaho woroc angmuya soroc yogung. Owi obugu yuhon birucno wömai 12 ihoroc idoc.
Tuna Yesuho mata orongi inongga yogoc, “Son yapmu ngorochon fatno owi amna au fandat inoninga.” Ihoroc inongga yogoc, “Owi obugu nacno au imuya nahun.”
